title: AdventureTemplate
description: A concrete adventure剧本骨架 (blueprint Review v4.0: AI is the DIRECTOR, not the author — templates are human-designed skeletons, AI fills variables). MVP library: 10 templates — discovery×3, build×2, social×2, emotion×2, math×1. Each template binds to one Growth Pattern (which owns the chapter mechanics).

goal_capability.description: The capability this adventure primarily develops.

structure.description: Plot beats (zh), e.g. ['发现困难', '寻找办法', '帮助朋友', '回顾感谢'].

theme_slots.description: Variable slots the AI may personalize (character/place/problem).
